items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I remember one time Teddy Beckner and Sidney Bechet was playing somewhere...

ctx.x: I remember one time Teddy Beckner and Sidney Bechet was playing somewhere and Teddy, when they got to the end of the number, Teddy made a high F. Dammit that made him so mad he just, it just seemed that Teddy was trying to top him. He got so mad at Teddy he called the whole

band out on the stand and made them play the whole number again. Teddy made the high F again. (LAUGHTER). they almost had to separate them because he couldn't call them back to play it three times. Teddy did it purposely. But there is nothing wrong in him making a high note. But Sidney didn't want him to hit a note, anywhere near as high as he was hitting see.
That's strange, you know, with all the talent he had that he had to be like that.
